newsitem.title: UK: Barrick plans to double size in 10 years.
newsitem.headline: Barrick plans to double size in 10 years.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp intends to double its size over the next 10 years, company chairman and chief executive officer Peter Munk said on Thursday.
The investment climate in places such as South America, where Barrick has interests, had warmed in recent years, he said.
"That gives me the certainty and confidence that..in the next decade we will be double what we are in this decade," Munk told an RBC Dominion Securities conference of gold mining industry leaders.

Barrick intends to stay in gold mining "exclusively". But it planned to continue expanding geographically, focussing on countries marked by minimal political risk and a good legal structure, Munk said.
"We industrialists and multinationals who can mobilise revenue are being wooed and offered incentives to exploit these countries' potential," he said.
Barrick last month completed a C$1 billion takeover of the smaller exploration company Arequipa Resources Ltd, solidifying its position as the world's third-biggest gold producer.
